def quat_slerp(a, b, t: float) -> np.ndarray:
    a = np.asarray(a, np.float64); b = np.asarray(b, np.float64)
    d = float(np.dot(a, b))
    if d < 0:
        b, d = -b, -d
    if d > 0.9995:
        q = a + t * (b - a)
        return q / np.linalg.norm(q)
    th = math.acos(min(1.0, d))
    return (math.sin((1 - t) * th) * a + math.sin(t * th) * b) / math.sin(th)

"""Generate a deterministic 11-stroke brush trajectory for the frozen 國 instance."""
import json, time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.interpolate import PchipInterpolator
from PIL import Image
from rcb_brush import Session
PX=.22185986964255727

def trajectory(nodes, speed=90):
    n=np.array(nodes,float)
    seg=np.linalg.norm(np.diff(n[:,:2],axis=0),axis=1)
    t=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.maximum(seg,3))]
    tt=np.linspace(0,t[-1],max(2,int(t[-1]/speed*100)+1))
    out=PchipInterpolator(t,n,axis=0)(tt)
    tangent=PchipInterpolator(t,n[:,:2],axis=0).derivative()(tt)
    tangent/=np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(tangent,axis=1)[:,None],1e-9)
    depth=(out[:,2]*PX+.3)/1.187
    offset=np.maximum(0,11.15-9.67*(np.minimum(depth,15)/10-1.091)**2)/PX
    tips=out[:,:2]+offset[:,None]*tangent
    p=np.column_stack([tips,depth])
    before=np.column_stack([np.tile(tips[0],(int((depth[0]+1)/.12)+1,1)),np.linspace(-1,depth[0],int((depth[0]+1)/.12)+1)])
    after=np.column_stack([np.tile(tips[-1],(int((depth[-1]+1)/.12)+1,1)),np.linspace(depth[-1],-1,int((depth[-1]+1)/.12)+1)])
    return np.ascontiguousarray(np.r_[before,p,after],dtype=np.float64)

def main():
    nodes=json.load(open('/app/output/trial_nodes.json'))
    s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json'); p=s.primitives();s.reset();s.record_start()
    errors=[]
    for i,n in enumerate(nodes):
        # A fresh dip restores the brush before each conventional stroke.
        p['move_tip']([*s.tip_pose()[0][:2],.055],speed=.07,settle=3)
        p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.055],speed=.13,settle=3)
        p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.023],speed=.05,settle=4)
        p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.055],speed=.08,settle=3)
        arr=trajectory(n)
        xx,yy=s.geo.px_to_world(arr[:,0],arr[:,1])
        world=np.column_stack([xx,yy,.02-arr[:,2]/1000])
        first=world[0]
        p['move_tip']([first[0],first[1]+.006,.05],speed=.13,settle=3)
        p['move_tip']([first[0],first[1]+.006,.021],speed=.04,settle=3)
        p['move_tip'](first,speed=.015,settle=8)
        # Sample the prescribed smooth tip path at 20 Hz, compensating the
        # measured 93 ms PD lag with velocity feedforward.
        for k in range(5,len(world)+5,5):
            j=min(k,len(world)-1); prev=max(0,j-5)
            vel=(world[j]-world[prev])/(.01*(j-prev)) if j>prev else np.zeros(3)
            target=world[j]+.093*vel
            q,ok,err=s.ik(target)
            if not ok: raise RuntimeError(('IK',i,j,err))
            s.step(q)
            errors.append(s.tip_pose()[0]-world[j])
        p['move_tip']([*world[-1,:2],.055],speed=.06,settle=6)
        print('stroke',i+1,'steps',s.n_steps,'maxerr',np.max(np.linalg.norm(errors,axis=1))*1000,flush=True)
    p['hold'](10)
    actions=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(actions,'/app/output/trajectory.npz')
    Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save('/app/output/canvas.png')
    np.save('/app/output/ink.npy',s.ink())
    import pickle
    pickle.dump(s.strokes(),open('/app/output/strokes.pkl','wb'))
    print('actions',len(actions),'state',s.state_sha(),'track mean/max mm',np.mean(np.linalg.norm(errors,axis=1))*1000,np.max(np.linalg.norm(errors,axis=1))*1000,flush=True)
    score=s.score();json.dump(score,open('/app/output/score.json','w'),indent=2);print(score,flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__': main()
PY
